description: Source code for the SQL store implementation of plugin key-value management in Mattermost, including methods for saving, updating, comparing, deleting, and listing plugin key-value pairs.

classes.name: SqlPluginStore
classes.description: Implements plugin key-value storage operations using SQL database.

methods.name: SaveOrUpdate
methods.description: Inserts or updates a plugin key-value pair in the database.

methods.name: CompareAndSet
methods.description: Atomically compares and sets a plugin key-value pair.

methods.name: CompareAndDelete
methods.description: Atomically compares and deletes a plugin key-value pair.

methods.name: SetWithOptions
methods.description: Sets a plugin key-value pair with additional options, optionally atomically.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a plugin key-value pair by plugin ID and key.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a plugin key-value pair by plugin ID and key.

methods.name: DeleteAllForPlugin
methods.description: Deletes all key-value pairs for a specific plugin.

methods.name: DeleteAllExpired
methods.description: Deletes all expired plugin key-value pairs.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Lists keys for a plugin, with pagination.
